title: Fair or foul?
instruction: Your classmates are creating with AI. What is fair and what is a foul?

items.text: An AI poster with the sentence “created with the help of AI”
A picture in the style of a living illustrator, sold as your own drawing
items.why: It takes her style and her work, and lies about who made it.

items.text: An AI “photo” of a castle in a school report, unchecked and unlabelled
items.why: It passes off something made up as a fact.

items.text: A design from AI that you redrew, saying where the idea came from
items.why: Your own work and an honestly disclosed source.

items.text: A deepfake video of a classmate as a joke for the group chat
items.why: Without consent and at their expense. That is bullying.

items.text: An illustration for a fairy tale: chosen from ten, edited and labelled
items.why: You decided, and you said so.

debrief: Fair means disclosing AI, checking what a picture claims, and not taking someone else’s style or face without consent. Whoever published the result is responsible for it.
